title: Shopping Cart
content: Create shopping cart page with full functionality. Layout: main cart area (items list) + order summary sidebar (sticky). Cart items: product image (w-24), name link, selected variants, unit price, quantity selector, line total, remove button. Quantity updates: optimistic update. Empty cart: illustration with "Your cart is empty" message, "Continue Shopping" CTA. Order summary: subtotal, shipping, tax estimate, promo code input, order total. Checkout button prominent. Mobile: full-width layout, sticky checkout bar at bottom.

variants.simple: Create cart page with item list, quantities, and order total.
variants.detailed: Create shopping cart page with full functionality. Layout: main cart area (items list) + order summary sidebar (sticky). Cart items: product image (w-24), name link, selected variants, unit price, quantity selector, line total, remove button. Quantity updates: optimistic update. Empty cart: illustration with "Your cart is empty" message, "Continue Shopping" CTA. Order summary: subtotal, shipping, tax estimate, promo code input, order total. Checkout button prominent. Mobile: full-width layout, sticky checkout bar at bottom.
variants.advanced: Create shopping cart page with full functionality and excellent UX. Layout: max-w-7xl mx-auto, flex gap-8, main cart area (flex-1) + order summary sidebar (w-96 flex-shrink-0 sticky top-4). Cart items list: divide-y divide-gray-200. Cart item row: flex gap-4 py-6. Item content: product image (w-24 h-24 rounded-lg object-cover) linking to product page, info column (flex-1) with product name link (font-medium hover:underline), selected variants displayed (Size: M, Color: Blue) in text-gray-500 text-sm, unit price. Actions column: quantity selector component (compact variant), line total (font-medium text-right), remove button (Trash2 icon or text "Remove" text-red-600 hover:underline). Quantity updates: optimistic UI update immediately, debounced API call, revert on error with toast. Empty cart: centered content with shopping bag illustration, "Your cart is empty" heading, "Looks like you have not added anything yet" subtext, "Continue Shopping" primary CTA button. Save for later: text button to move item to saved items section below cart. Recently viewed: "You may also like" section showing recently viewed products in horizontal scroll. Order summary card: bg-gray-50 rounded-lg p-6. Summary rows: Subtotal (items total), Shipping ("Calculated at checkout" or actual amount or "FREE" badge), Estimated Tax, Discount row if promo applied (text-green-600 with negative amount), Order total (text-xl font-bold). Promo code: collapsible section with input and Apply button. Checkout button: w-full bg-black text-white py-4 rounded-lg font-medium, disabled if cart empty. Trust badges below: accepted payment icons (Visa, MC, Amex, PayPal), "Secure checkout" with Lock icon. Mobile layout: stack vertically, order summary collapses into accordion or moves to bottom, sticky "Checkout ($X)" bar at bottom of screen with total. Loading states: skeleton items during initial load, subtle opacity during quantity updates. Handle out-of-stock: show warning if item became unavailable, suggest alternatives.

author: Ersin KOÇ
